meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把提供的文本当作分析对象,提取作者的认知模式与思考痕迹。它按 12 个维度打分,识别优势、薄弱与张力组合,输出认知画像(推理拓扑、决策方式等)。多份文本时,还能比较不同作者的思维异同。
howto.when: 当用户提到“思维模式”“DHDNA”“认知画像”等关键词,或要求分析某人如何思考、比较不同人的思维方式,或提供文本想了解其推理与决策风格时触发。

say.text: 分析这段文字,给我它的认知画像。
say.note: Claude 会对文本按 12 个维度评分并输出画像。

say.text: 对比我和另一个人的写作,谁更偏直觉?
say.note: 进入对比模式,比较两篇文本的认知差异。

say.text: 用我们这段对话给我做个思维档案。
say.note: 以对话历史为样本自我画像,并提示其局限。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes provided text, extracts cognitive patterns, scores 12 dimensions, identifies dominant/shadow/tensions, and outputs a cognitive profile (topology, decision style, quotes). With multiple texts, it compares authors.
howto.when_en: Triggered by keywords like "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "cognitive profile", or by requests to analyze someone's thinking, compare thinking styles, or understand an author's reasoning from provided text.

say_en.text: Analyze this text and give me its cognitive profile.
say_en.note: Claude scores the text on 12 dimensions and outputs a profile.

say_en.text: Compare my writing with another person's—who leans more intuitive?
say_en.note: Enters comparison mode and contrasts the two cognitive profiles.

say_en.text: Build a thinking profile from our conversation so far.
say_en.note: Profiles you from chat history, noting its limits.
